strategy.thesis: Sector-focused early-stage VC investing in 'synergistic industries' — its second fund is a dedicated Mobility & Supply Chain Fund backing smart mobility, transportation, logistics and supply-chain optimisation startups across Southeast Asia.

summary.en: Kuala Lumpur-based, sector-focused early-stage VC founded in 2018 by ex-Gobi investor Victor Chua. Its first SEA fund targeted US$40M; its second is a dedicated US$30M-target Mobility & Supply Chain Fund (LPs include KWAP, Sime Darby, MAVCAP, AEI Capital) backing smart mobility, transportation, logistics and supply-chain startups across Southeast Asia. First deal from the new fund was Thailand's tyre marketplace WYZauto.

strategy.thesis: Consortium-backed, maritime-dedicated tech fund (powered by Rainmaking) investing in startups that digitise and decarbonise the global maritime supply chain. Fund II — the largest maritime-focused tech fund to date — targets at least 25 companies.

summary.en: Singapore-based, consortium-driven maritime tech fund launched February 2021 (powered by Rainmaking), with Wilhelmsen and HHLA as anchor LPs. Its US$100M Fund II (March 2025) is the largest maritime-focused tech fund to date, backed by 17+ maritime corporates, writing US$250K–US$10M cheques into at least 25 companies to digitise and decarbonise the maritime supply chain. 30+ investments across both funds.

strategy.thesis: The venture-capital arm and venture builder of global port operator PSA International, investing across four themes — Terminal Technology, Green Energy Transition, Supply Chain & Logistics, and Data & Digital — to drive sustainable innovation in global supply chains.

summary.en: The dedicated VC arm and venture builder of PSA International (operator of 70+ terminals across 45 countries), evolved in 2025 from the PSA unboXed accelerator. Invests across Terminal Technology, Green Energy Transition, Supply Chain & Logistics and Data & Digital, with a global emphasis and particular focus on Southeast Asia. Portfolio includes Haulio, Deliveree, Roambee and Venti Technologies.

strategy.thesis: Impact venture fund dedicated to decarbonising the transportation sector (transport of goods and people, ~20% of global CO2). Backs fleet electrification, micromobility, battery circularity, hydrogen technologies and AI-powered energy-saving software across Europe and Southeast Asia.

summary.en: Paris- and Singapore-headquartered impact venture fund dedicated to decarbonising transport, with a €220M first close (vs €300M target). Writes €4M–€20M Series A/B cheques across fleet electrification, micromobility, battery circularity and hydrogen in Europe and Southeast Asia. 13 portfolio companies across seven countries; LPs include Renault Group, BNP Paribas, Bpifrance and the European Investment Fund.

strategy.thesis: The corporate VC arm of transport operator ComfortDelGro, investing in transport-related technology — vehicle fleet electrification, automotive engineering, autonomous-vehicle fleet management — plus adjacent smart logistics, AI, cybersecurity and robotics.

summary.en: The US$100M corporate venture capital fund of Singapore-listed transport operator ComfortDelGro, set up in late 2018. Targets transport-related tech — fleet electrification, automotive engineering, autonomous-vehicle fleet management — and adjacent smart logistics, AI, cybersecurity and robotics. Early deals include logistics platform Haulio, shared-mobility firm SWAT and AV-safety startup Foretellix.

strategy.thesis: Corporate venturing arm of Thai conglomerate SCG (Siam Cement). Focuses on B2B / industrial / enterprise verticals — including logistics and industrial-supply marketplaces, supply-chain, industrial automation, energy (solar/storage/EV) and net-zero — leveraging SCG's network across Southeast Asia.

summary.en: The corporate venturing arm of Thai conglomerate SCG (Siam Cement), launched 2017 with an initial US$85M (Bt2.89bn) over 3–5 years. Invests in B2B/industrial/enterprise startups — including logistics and industrial-supply marketplaces, supply-chain, industrial automation and energy (solar, storage, EV) — leveraging SCG's regional network. Has backed cross-border logistics platform Janio.
